_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/modes/test_modes_not_chosen_this_turn.py. t_mtt_rotation is Parapet Thrasher's line on an enchantment: a per-seat combat-damage trigger whose choose_mode is once_each "turn". The bodies are t_bcd_wyrm from batched_combat_damage.cards.json.

cards.name: Test Wyrm Rotation
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to an opponent, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• That player loses 5 life.
• You gain 3 life.
• Draw a card.
